start_with: Confirm that the expected page uses the intended Content Channel View or Content Channel Item View block and the intended channel.
Check the item’s approval status and whether the channel requires approval.
Check Start and Expire dates using the date model defined by the channel type.
Inspect block status filters, item filters, context filters, route parameters, and ordering.
If the item contains Lava, verify that the item-view block processes `Item.Content` with `RunLava`.
If personalization is enabled, inspect the channel setting, item assignments, and the block’s Ignore, Prioritize, or Filter choice.
Check View and Interact permissions separately.
If the content is being rendered through RSS, test without current-person or page-context assumptions. (Add a Content Channel Item, Content Channel View Block, Personalize Content Channel Items)
branches.title: A content item does not appear
branches.when: A content item does not appear

start_with: Confirm that the user has View permission on the channel; that controls whether the channel appears under `Tools > Content`.
Clear or adjust the status, date-range, and title filters.
If the item is pending, use the pending-only channel toggle to locate the channel.
Confirm that approvals are enabled for the channel.
Confirm that the user’s role has `Approve` on `Rock.Model.ContentChannelType`.
For missing add/delete controls, record the installed version and determine whether the Rock 19.3 fix applies. (Manage Content Items, Secure Content, Rock Core Release Notes)
branches.title: Staff cannot find or approve a channel item
branches.when: Staff cannot find or approve a channel item

start_with: Confirm an active Universal Search index component.
Confirm the expected channel or calendar is a source in the collection.
Confirm the needed item attributes were selected for indexing.
Run `Index Content Collections` or use Rebuild Index after same-day changes.
Confirm filters are enabled both in the collection and in the Content Collection View block.
Recheck the block’s selected collection, search-on-load behavior, result count, and templates.
If personalization is involved, verify site personalization and the block’s boost configuration.
Stop before exposing the collection if it contains restricted items; individual item security is not enforced by the collection. (Troubleshoot Content Collections, Content Collection View)
branches.title: Content Collection results are stale or empty
branches.when: Content Collection results are stale or empty

start_with: Confirm **Enable Personalization** on the exact site.
If browsing activity is required, confirm Enable Visitor Tracking on that site.
Confirm the item’s channel has personalization enabled.
Evaluate every segment filter area and its internal Any or All logic.
Refresh the persisted data view when person data has changed.
Run Update Personalization Data.
Allow for or inspect the `ROCK_SEGMENT_FILTERS` cookie affinity interval.
Evaluate Request Filters against the current site, device, query, cookie, IP, location, day, and time.
branches.title: Personalized content is wrong or stale
branches.when: Personalized content is wrong or stale

start_with: Disable output caching on the affected Content Channel View or Content Component block.
Clear the relevant rendered-output cache.
Retest with separate browser sessions.
Inspect parent-page, CDN, or proxy caching if the symptom persists.
Stop publication until cross-visitor isolation is demonstrated. (Content Channel View Block, Configure Content Components)
branches.title: One visitor sees another visitor’s personalized values
branches.when: One visitor sees another visitor’s personalized values

do_not_assume: Retest with an appropriate clean or known viewer context; do not assume an anonymous session shares an identified person’s history.
start_with: Confirm the page or communication invokes the intended Adaptive Message.
Check the adaptation’s date window.
Check its segment and request-context qualification.
Check whether an earlier ordered adaptation also qualifies.
If view tracking is enabled, inspect whether the saturation count was reached within the configured day range.
Retest with an appropriate clean or known viewer context; do not assume an anonymous session shares an identified person’s history. (Set Up Adaptive Messages)
branches.title: An Adaptive Message adaptation does not display
branches.when: An Adaptive Message adaptation does not display

start_with: Confirm that the expected storage provider and folder are selected.
Refresh the Asset Manager folder.
Confirm the editor is using an Asset attribute or asset picker tied to that provider.
If the issue is a preview rather than existence, distinguish provider listing, Rock preview support, and public delivery.
Verify provider/plugin configuration in the installed instance before changing content references. (View Asset Manager, Add Content)
branches.title: An externally uploaded asset is missing
branches.when: An externally uploaded asset is missing

do_not_assume: Do not infer lack of engagement solely from analytics until player configuration and interaction logging are verified.
start_with: Confirm the page passes a Media Element GUID to the shortcode’s `media` parameter when Media Element analytics are required.
If `src` is used, identify whether it points to the intended generated file variant.
Inspect `autoresumeindays` and `combineplaystatisticsindays`.
Confirm whether the return occurred inside or outside the configured window.
Record the Rock version; if interaction entity classification appears wrong, assess the Rock 17.5 fix.
Do not infer lack of engagement solely from analytics until player configuration and interaction logging are verified. (Use With Content Channel Items, Rock Core Release Notes)
branches.title: Media analytics or resume behavior is unexpected
branches.when: Media analytics or resume behavior is unexpected

start_with: Confirm the Media Watch attribute is visible and editable on the workflow entry form.
Confirm it has one assigned video.
Check the required watch percentage.
Confirm the participant watched enough unique seconds; seeking forward does not count.
Inspect the lookback period. Blank or zero disables auto-resume.
Retest using the same participant context intended by the workflow. (Use Digital Media in Workflows)
branches.title: A required Media Watch form cannot be submitted
branches.when: A required Media Watch form cannot be submitted

start_with: Confirm the page description in Page Settings.
Inspect the rendered Open Graph or Twitter/X metadata.
Confirm the image metadata contains a reachable website image URL.
Confirm `twitter:card` matches the desired card size.
For Facebook, run the Share Validator and review its preview and diagnostics.
For calendar events, confirm the template uses the intended network-specific event image attribute. (Intro to Social Networks, Facebook, Twitter/X)
branches.title: A social share preview is wrong
branches.when: A social share preview is wrong

start_with: Identify whether the problem concerns display, entry validation, or downstream processing.
For dates and times, inspect server culture in System Information.
For phones, inspect Phone Country Code ordering, regular expressions, and formatting expressions.
For currency display, inspect Organization Currency Code and Lava formatting.
Independently confirm payment-gateway currency; a symbol change does not reconfigure it.

For addresses, confirm Support International Addresses and the selected country’s labels, format, and states. (Localize Dates & Times, Localize Phone Numbers, Localize Currency, Configure International Addresses)
branches.title: Dates, phone numbers, currency, or addresses appear incorrectly localized
branches.when: Dates, phone numbers, currency, or addresses appear incorrectly localized

entrypoint: Choose the branch whose symptom matches the user's task, then inspect the live records before making changes.
